title: A refused Supabase token redded every open PR: check:migrations failed PRs that touch no migration

source.ref: ci checks jobs 109691526835 (#3079), #3085 and #3065, 2026-09-30 01:04Z to 01:06Z: 'ledger query HTTP 401 from the Supabase Management API. {"message":"Unauthorized"}'

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. MEASURED: from 01:04Z the Supabase Management API answered HTTP 401 to the CI secret SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, and the required checks job went red on every open PR (#3079, #3085, #3065, #3081, #3086), none of which adds or changes a migration. The same step passed on #3087 at 00:55Z, and the dashboard shows the token unexpired (08 Dec 2026). The owner's ruling: change the rule so a dead CI credential stops jamming the queue. WHAT CHANGED: a 401 or 403 from the Management API, on a pull_request run whose diff against origin/<base> names no file under supabase/migrations, returns `refused`: exit 0, loud lines saying nothing was compared, and a ::warning annotation naming the owner action. It stays a failure on a PR that touches a migration, on every push to main (the gate that notices the dead token), when the diff cannot be read, and for every other status, transport failure or malformed payload.

CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1670). scripts/check-migrations.test.ts drives every branch with injected seams.

verify.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import {ledgerCheck,prTouchesMigrations} from './scripts/check-migrations.mjs';const env={SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:'t',SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:'r'};const repo={readdir:()=>[]};const fetch=async()=>({ok:false,status:401,text:async()=>'{}'});const go=(t)=>ledgerCheck({env,argv:[],total:700,io:{repo,fetch,prTouchesMigrations:t}});const a=await go(false),b=await go(true),c=await go(undefined);const d=prTouchesMigrations({env:{GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:'push'},runGit:()=>''});if(!(a.ok&&a.status==='refused'&&!b.ok&&!c.ok&&d===undefined)){console.error('HYG-154: a refused token must relax only a PR that touches no migration',a.status,b.status,c.status,d);process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: The consequence: a 401 on a PR with no migration change is ok (refused), and the same 401 still fails a migration PR and a run whose diff is unknown, which is every push to main. On main before this change the import of prTouchesMigrations fails.
